verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists individual API endpoints (create one contact, send one campaign, add one route) and account-level export, but nothing documents a batch/bulk API (e.g., bulk create/update of contacts or bulk campaign operations) that would let an AI agent operate across many items in one call. missing for 10: batch endpoint documentation, bulk contact import/update API, bulk campaign management, rate-limit guidance for large-scale automation.
